tagline.en_US: An open-source business intelligence platform for querying data and building dashboards. This single-container profile uses embedded H2 for a home-lab trial or small instance; PostgreSQL is recommended for production.

description.en_US: Metabase is an open-source business intelligence and data visualization platform. It allows users to query databases using either a visual question builder or a native SQL editor without requiring deep technical expertise. Users can create interactive dashboards, configure automated alerts, and distribute scheduled reports via email, Slack, or webhooks.
